title: Merges resume when the revert merges
ruling: Owner 13:20 CST Nov 13, page item 745 b (against the triage recommendation a): after a red main, merges resume when the revert merges, with the revert's own run still going. The merge tool and decision no-merge-onto-red-main change. Ruling ow-29 (item 622 b) stands.
